title: Association Study Between Periodontal Disease and Male Infertility
brief_summary: The aim of the present study is to examine the association between fertility parameters and the periodontal status of men attending fertility and in vitro fertilization clinic.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Consent to participate in study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Systemic uncontrolled disease
study_population: Males attending in vitro fertiliztion clinic
